bias.en: Bearish · lost the 200-day and the October lows
bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 200 日均线和 10 月低点

read.en: Arm fell 10.0% on Oct 30 to $205.97, trading between $198.77 and $209.00 on 2.3 times average volume. It is below the rising 5-day ($224.1) and falling 10-day ($221.7), the falling 30-day ($265.0) and 100-day ($281.2) and the rising 200-day ($228.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 7 and below zero, histogram widening again; Parabolic SAR turned bearish on Oct 30 ($237.88), and RSI is 35.
read.zh: Arm 10月30日下跌 10.0%，收于 $205.97，盘中区间 $198.77–209.00，成交量为均量的 2.3 倍。股价低于上行的 5 日（$224.1）和下行的 10 日均线（$221.7），以及下行的 30 日（$265.0）、100 日均线（$281.2）和上行的 200 日均线（$228.9）。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图再度扩大；抛物线 SAR 于 10月30日转为看空（$237.88），RSI 为 35。

read.en: The slide broke all three written supports ($221.3–229, incl. the 200-day) and the $208.3–208.5 Oct 22–23 lows, now resistance, and flipped the SAR bearish. Resistance is $208.3–209, then $221.7–224.1 (10 and 5-day) and $228.9 (200-day). Support is $198.8–200.9 (Oct 30 and May 12 lows), then $193.9–195 (Apr 28–29 lows) and $178.5–179.4. A close above $209 would target $222–224; below $198.8, $194.
